Q: What is n indexed relative to (per tool, per session, or global) and is it 1-based?
A: n is a 1-based index counted per tool name in chronological order over the matching toolResult entries (not global across tools). Out-of-range or zero indices fail. Name matching is exact and case-sensitive.
Task: Document how TaskManage resolves tool:Name#n evidence
